prompt:
A single professional logo lockup for a software platform named "Rangkita", an Indonesian SaaS platform that hosts several applications for Islamic education institutions. Flat vector brand identity, centered on a clean solid white background with generous padding. ONE logo only — not a grid, not variations, not a collage, not a mockup.

CONCEPT — "many beads strung into one line": the emblem is a rising arc formed by a row of simple geometric shapes (circles and rounded squares) of graduated size, connected by a single thin continuous line that threads through them. It reads as separate units joined into one progression — growth, sequence, memorization step by step. Compact, contained within a rough square footprint. Abstract and modern — NOT a chart, NOT a graph, NOT a prayer bead necklace drawn literally, NOT a mosque.

WORDMARK: the single word "Rangkita" beside or below the emblem, in a warm humanist sans-serif, medium weight, open letterforms, comfortable letter spacing, perfectly spelled.

COLOR: warm terracotta clay as the primary color, paired with a muted olive green on a few of the shapes for rhythm. Absolutely NO navy blue, NO dark blue, NO teal. Earthy, human, warm, calm.

STYLE: flat design, solid fills, no gradients, no drop shadows, no 3D, no textures, no outline box around the logo. Crisp vector edges. Must stay legible and recognizable at a 16px favicon size.

STRICT: no people, no hands, no faces, no Arabic calligraphy, no crescent moon, no star, no photographic elements, no background pattern, no extra text, no tagline, no trademark symbol.
quality_reason: Aset identitas merek, wordmark harus tajam dan ejaan tepat
